transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. I'd like to get our pre-lock round-robin started so we can move toward final production approval. Let's go through each area: technical, rights, talent, and accessibility leads — please report your final operating requirements. I need to hear from all four before I can sign off on the package.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to flag a critical technical finding before we proceed. My completed radio-frequency survey found that wireless roaming camera links interfere with the theater's assistive-listening loop. Because of that, the gala must use three fixed wired cameras from the marked camera platforms — no wireless roaming cameras. I filed the survey in the technical folder, but it's not on Mara's draft lock sheet yet, so I want to make sure it's formally on the record now.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I need to flag a critical rights restriction before we proceed. My signed performance license — which I received countersigned this morning — permits the gala broadcast but explicitly prohibits any video-on-demand release or later promotional clips. The recording must be marked broadcast-only. This directly conflicts with the current draft package's provision permitting the recording to be reused in the festival archive. I have not yet entered this restriction in the rights tracker, but it is binding. The archive reuse provision must be removed or we will be in breach of the license.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: I need to flag a critical talent constraint before we proceed. I confirmed with the headliner's agent that the performer can soundcheck only at exactly 3:00 PM on Saturday, and the rider explicitly prohibits sponsor product placement anywhere on the performance stage. I have the agent's confirmation in email, but it is not in the production schedule. This directly conflicts with the current draft package's provision that includes a sponsor product display on stage. The sponsor product display on stage must be removed or we will be in breach of the headliner's rider.
transcript.speaker: A4

transcript.text: I need to flag a critical accessibility requirement before we proceed. My accessibility vendor confirmed that the live caption feed requires the captioner to work from Booth B, whose dedicated return feed is connected to the gala's caption encoder. The general plan's control-room location will not work for the caption feed. I documented the vendor confirmation in the accessibility file, but I have not yet added the booth assignment to the lock sheet. Booth B must be formally assigned for the captioner on the lock sheet.
transcript.speaker: A5

decisions.camera_configuration: Three fixed wired cameras from the marked camera platforms; no wireless roaming cameras permitted.
decisions.archive_release: Broadcast-only; the festival archive reuse provision is removed from the package.
decisions.stage_sponsor_treatment: Sponsor product display on stage is removed; no sponsor product placement on the performance stage.
decisions.captioner_location: Booth B, assigned for the captioner with its dedicated return feed connected to the gala's caption encoder.

commitments.detail: Add the RF survey finding and three-fixed-wired-camera requirement to the lock sheet, replacing any wireless roaming camera references.
Enter the broadcast-only restriction in the rights tracker and remove the festival archive reuse provision from the draft package.
Add the headliner's 3:00 PM Saturday soundcheck to the production schedule and remove the on-stage sponsor product display from the package.
Formally assign Booth B for the captioner on the lock sheet, with the dedicated return feed connected to the gala's caption encoder.
